nom: Clinique All About Clean 2-in-1 Face Cleansing + Exfoliating Jelly Cleanser with Salicylic Acid

avis.texte: Yall ive been using this product for 13 years!! And will forever hype it up, i use it daily with another soft cleanser and i have never had any complaints, my skin has always been very dry until i started using it, i have hardly any black heads and i only break out( 2-3 pimples) rarley!!! Its very gentel and can definitely feel clean

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again
avis.texte: I have tried other products in the past, but always come back to this one

avis.titre: Great for hard white pimples and blackheads
avis.texte: Always have had great complextion! I guess i took after my mother and grandmother! We just lost her not too long ago and her complextion was beautiful for an almost 103 yrs old lady that was in perfect health,had all her teeth walk Fisk! Exercised and sharp as a tact! And no face surgeries! 2 months ago I had a flair up with my lupus after falling in a grocery store and a display fell on me fracturing 10 bones! My face turned into a mess i guess all that medicine and found this and it took only 1 month to clear up my wholelife i have had beautiful comlextion face! I have not had any face surgeries and will be 74 yrs in Nov! Now using 3 times a day instead of 7 days and a milder face wash the other 4 days! On the shelf at all times! It was like a miracle! Thank you Clinique for a great product! I hope this gets posted because my other one was ignored! No more reviews from me until I see this posted! I think this could help alot of men and women! Have a Blessed Day, Pam p.s. i also have lupus really bad! And this did not hurt me at all!
It cleans very well, and lasts for long. I use it 2 times a week and my blackheads and acne is better
It really cleans your faceof everything and your face is smooth
Its good for deep cleaning face wash ni more whiteade or blackheads its acne safe

If you have sensitive skin move along. This tore up my skin and it took weeks to get it back to normal. It dried out the sensitive area around my nose and eyes. It made my skin red and my acne WORSE. Used for only 2 weeks and I will never buy again

avis.titre: Face feels so clean after using!
avis.texte: I purchased this cleanser on a whim, but I don't think I can change course now. After using, my face feels smooth and fresh rather than dried out, which can happen with exfoliating cleansers. The beads feel refreshing without being too harsh. I do notice a difference in my skin as I have less breakouts and less whiteheads on my chin. This product is well worth the money!
I love this cleanser I have been using this product for years! Not every day but every few days bc its pretty exfoliating.

avis.titre: Perfect for Acne prone, sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I have been using Clinique Anti Blemish range for more than a decade now. Didn't try any other cleanser until I received this cleanser as a freebie. Absolutely loved it!! Have now started buying this cleanser along with my Anti-Blemish range. This cleanser provides mild cleansing and also helps reduce blackheads. Amazing product! Thankyou Clinique :)

This is great stuff and my new favorite face wash. I like it much better than the foaming cleanser. This is so easy to us--washes off easily, feels good, cleans very well, and a little goes a long way. Now please make a travel size version. Thank you.
This is a great cleanser and exfoliating thst isn't too harsh on my skin. I use it everyday and my skin looks great.
This is the best face wash! It has the perfect amount of scrubbers in it that it doesn't irritate my face or over exfoliate.
Have been a loyal Clinique user for 40 years. Another great product.
Excellent source of clean and - it cleanses without drying and leaves you feeling renewed

I have been using this cleanser for over a year now and really like it. I like that it makes my face feel smoother each day and it is not too harsh to use daily. For me, this works better than the 7th day scrub.
I recently got this daily scrub and so far I'm loving it! Leaves my fl face nice and smooth
I love this face wash, its the perfect amount of exfoliation and leaves my skin feeling so refeshed and smooth.
This cleanser is amazing. I use it 2-3 times a week, at night, as my cleansing exfolliant. It is gentle but effective.
This is a good face scrub but it's definitely more on the mild side of exfoliation properties.

The only thing that has been successful in tempering the hormonal acne I suddenly developed in my mid-thirties. My skin got a lot drier but also more acne prone; the combo of salicylic acid and an exfoliant is very effective.
I use this every morning without irritation. It makes my skin glow and makeup go on smoothly. Love it!

I bought this with my own money. This is the best "polishing" cleanser out there, intended to be used every day. My skin loves this. Breakouts can be expected as it exfoliates and releases trapped comedones but after two weeks, I had no problems. To me, this is a perfect cleanser. I will buy this forever and PRAY they do not change the formula or discontinue!
I've been using. This for many years, I love the light exploration and the clean results. I get with my skin.
I have tried a few of the clinique scrubs and I prefer this one. I like that it comes in a gell and it doesn't feel too harsh but yet does a good job of refining skin

I've got 7 decades under my belt and used this product twice. My chin looks like it did when I was 15 - all kinds of bumps! I don't usually write reviews, but I had to on this one. It's been 3 weeks now, and am hoping this is ending soon.

My chin has been clogged with closed comedonws for months, nothing worked, I changed moisturizer, cut out products, nothing was working until I started using this wash! It does make my rosacea flare so I just done use it on my cheeks, but my forehead and chin have never looked better!!
I like this product a lot. I like the combination of salicylic acid & a mild exfoliant for my prone to break outs skin.

The Clinique acne foam cleanser has been out of stock so I was forced to try something else and im so GLAD I switched to this . My stubborn acne and pumpy patches are totally gone after 3 days !!! I use the toner and dramatically different moisturizer with it . This is the best my skin has looked in 20 years . I wish i took a before and after picture because the results are amazing its like magic .

avis.titre: I have purchased this product over and over again
avis.texte: This cleanser has just the right amount of exfoliate and Cleaning power to make my face feel brand new every time I use it
Alittle goes a long way. If you use too much it's hard to rinse off but other than that it exfoliates, cleanses and makes my skin soft. I'm 44. I recommend.

avis.titre: The absolute best for my overly sensitive face!
avis.texte: My face is overly sensitive, and dramatic about it. This is the only cleanser I can use. I use it almost daily with no problem.

Love the consistency and grain size, it is gentle but you feel how it works for real. I've been using the 7 day scrub and this one feels more powerful. Hope it helps with black spots around nose and chin.
An Ulta Salesperson recommended this. I needed an exfoliator while traveling for a wedding. This is AWESOME! I've been using it consistently & still love the results. It is gentle.

I use this every evening. It removes all the makeup and what ever else has been on your skin throughout the day. Very good at smoothing the texture of my skin. I'm in my 50's and my skin changed a lot. It went from oily to patches of dryness and flakes. This cleanser was recommended for me through an online consultation. I didn't know it existed! I use the facial bar soap in the morning. I gave it four stars because I try not to buy too much plastic packaging.

I received this product as my free birthday gift. I was very excited to try it but am disappointed in this product. It does make my skin feel clean but it has an odor to it. I tried it again and still sense this same odor. Unfortunately, I will not be using this cleanser again nor will I order it.

avis.titre: Great for a one step cleanser!
avis.texte: I usually use the redness cleanser and 7 day scrub so when I received this as my birthday gift was worried it wouldn't work for my skin. I actually really like it! My skin feels really clean and smooth without any tightness. So far no breakouts, increased redness or dryness.

avis.titre: Makes my skin soft and clean
avis.texte: I got this product as a Birthday gift. It is good for skin types with acne problems. It really makes the skin feel clean and soft. I have been always using Acne Solutions Foam, but as it is out of stock and will not be back any more, I decided to start using this product.

avis.titre: I would not buy this again
avis.texte: Not sure what it's in this product that made my Chin and lower part of my face break out. I do have alot of food allergies i.e. corn eggs and dairy..not sure if it contains any of thoes ingredients. But after a week of using product my breakout won't go away.

I got this exfoliating jelly as a free item with my purchase. I really like this better than the Acne Solutions Cleansing gel or foam— pleasant and subtle smell. Better than the 7-day scrub too. The beads and salicylic acid really work— refreshing on a stressful day. There is nothing more that I could ask for in a daily cleanser! This is a new a favorite!

Makes my skin feel very clean, tight, and also helps to make my face look more radiant.. After my third day in using this 2+1 product, I went to the store with no makeup liquid foundation ( applied only eye liner and blush). A younger lady walked up to me and told me I was beautiful. I know fir sure, some thing is happening for sure with my skin. I am a believer.

I had used the exfoliating scrub for years until the formulation changed. I do not care for the greasy feel of the 7-day scrub. So, I was pleasantly surprised by this exfoliating cleanser. It is not greasy feeling and leaves my face feeling exfoliated but not dry. I received 1 bottle as a gift but I am now purchasing one as well.

This was a My Rewards gift (birthday). I don't think I would have purchased it otherwise, as I have been using the 7 Day Scrub for years. No more, this cleansing scrub is amazing. I thought it might be too harsh, but my skin looks so much smoother and clearer. I love it! And I hope it is never discontinued.

This delightfully-designed dual cleansing and exfoliating skincare wonder promotes both a smoother and clearer complexion. With its refreshing gel formula and gentle scrubbing beads, it brings one's facial cleansing routine to a whole new level of deep purifying and refining, making this product especially excellent for those with oily skin. Given its ingenious formula, 2-in-1 is an easy and efficacious way to double your cleansing pleasure!
My skin is much fresher and cleaner than using a foam cleanser.
I've tried everything and this blows me away . My skin has a glow and my pores appear smaller !!

avis.titre: I purchase this product all the time and I love it
avis.texte: It makes my skin so clean and it feels wonderful after using this after a full day
This is an excellent product that keeps my skin break out free!

After 3 weeks, so far I don't see that this product serves me as expected. It says it would remove buildups - so far I don't see any signs of it. The one thing I did notice, unfortunately, is developing a couple of really bad acnes.
My favorite face cleanser! Love the way my face feels while - and after - using it!
I like to use this before I shower, rinsing it off in the shower. It makes my skin feel really clean and smooth.

I got this cleanser + exfoliant as part of a summer bonus bag. While it wasn't on my shopping list, I was very pleased with the product! Every summer I struggle with acne on my back and chest. This clears it up! It's the only thing that has worked!

This is the best cleanser I've ever used having oily skin! It is difficult to find a product that can actually help your skin to keep it clean and in my case remove excess of oil. Since I started using this product I even noticed having less breakouts on my skin!
This was my first time trying this and it made my skin feel so soft and clean afterwards.

I wasn't happy with this product. I began to break out after using this (it was the only change in my skincare routine) and it did the opposite of its promise - my skin wasn't smooth after using. It was tougher than when I started. I am disappointed.
This product is cool and makes skin smooth and soft after first use this product. Love it .

I actually bought this a while ago and just started using it last month and I absolutely love it. This has to be the best exfoliater I have ever bought, it's perfect in every way. Gets my skin nice and clean and I also feel like it moisturizes it as well.

I am looking for a few new skin scrubs and potions :) As I look at the ingredients in each I was thrilled to see no Shea (a tree nut which many people react to! - if you notice any hives, itching, redness, swelling, or even additional bumps/breakouts, check your label for Shea!) as well as thrilled to see no almond or other nuts! That said, I was very surprised to see BHT on the list for this product! It is banned in many countries and still "up for discussion" in the USA as an additive in cosmetics. There are scientific abstracts which show in numerous studies that this chemically produced additive can cause potential reactions. (Ingesting it is a whole other issue) Clinique, you are the go to, the leader in safe, pure skincare and cosmetics. It would be fabulous if your engineers could revisit ingredient lists and remove harsh chemicals and overlooked allergens. (Lavender, chamomile, almond, walnut, shea, moringa, marula, and argan are all high on the list of supposed "great for your skin" allergens) Please always remain as clean, safe, and pure as you are!! PS Calyx has been my "go to" fragrance for over 20 years whenever I know I will be outdoors with a lot of mosquitoes! Especially when I'm golfing! Bugs HATE green scents! Calyx not only smells fantastic, it helps keep those pesky buggers away! Bravo! (Could you please add powder to the Calyx line?)
I've always used the 7-day scrub cream and didn't like that I had to cleanse first with a separate product. Thank you Clinique!

This scrub is amazing. I use it before the foam cleanser for oily skin in the pink tube. My face is squeaky clean afterwards but never irritated or flaky like some cleansers do to my skin. Moisture Surge 100h also keeps it hydrated but not oily. Great addition to my routine.

Equivalent to - or better than! - a motorized facial brush. I have oily skin and the first thing I want to do after I get home is wash my face. I was initially concerned that the smaller granules would not cleanse as well as some some scrubs, but as I continued to wash, my skin felt cleaner and smoother. This is without a doubt my all-time favorite cleanser!

avis.titre: I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this face cleanser!!
avis.texte: This face cleanser is superb! It is very gentle but yet exfoliates. It leaves your skin feeling really soft and I never feel like there is residual makeup still on my face. It cleans off all my makeup and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and soft. Please, NEVER stop selling this Clinique!!

Disclaimer: my skin is slightly sensitive, but not very. After using this the first time, I saw a bit of irritation but figured my skin was just purging. Same for the second. Third, even worse but I didn't think much of it. The fourth time… my skin turns bright red. It's incredibly itchy and painful. It felt like it was burning. Do not buy this.

Clinique is the master of face products. I often breakout when I try to wash my face with anything, which is why I do better when I just remove makeup and put on serum/moisturizer without washing. But about once every two I weeks, I need to exfoliate to give myself a deep clean, and I'm left with fresh, clear skin when I use this. Clinique never disappoints me with their face products: cleansers, makeup removers, moisturizers, etc.. This exfoliator is a winner.

This is the best solution between scrub and washing. One day we received this as a gift and found it to work for both of us: me and my husband for everyday use. Making a new order and will definitely add this product again. Thank you Clinique:)

avis.titre: A Great Clean and A Great Scrub
avis.texte: I double cleanse with this scrub and I love it. It cleanses without over drying and cleans out pores like a vacuum. My blackheads were noticeably reduced after one use. A must-have part of my regimen.

Got this from a gift set. It is a kind of jelly cleanser with bamboo beets in it. I only use it in summer or once a week in winter because I'm dry skin. Personally I prefer that kind of gentle cleanser but this could be used once a while.
My skin feels and looks better after using for a short period of time.
When I used this, it calmed down my skin and kept it gentle but effective at the same time.

avis.titre: Clinique is easily the best skin care I've ever used
avis.texte: I absolutely love Clinique Products I've been using them for over 30 years. I won't use any other cleanser on my face, anytime I've tried I've instantly regretted it. Five stars all the way!

I was looking for something to replace the Pepstart that was discontinued and decided to purchase this and give it a try. I love it! I use this every morning in the shower to cleanse and exfoliate in one easy step. It is very gentle and effective and I highly recommend!

I got this in a packaged set of items but really like it. I have used 7 Day Scrub for years but tried this and like the fine granules. Major difference is this foams more and you need to be careful about eye contact.
This face wash is amazing. It leave my skin feeling rejuvenated every time along with soft and smooth

I love this cleanser! I am fairly new to Clinique, about 2 years, and I started out with Pep Start, which I loved, only to find it was discontinued when I wanted to reorder. I got this cleanser in a set and it works like Pep Start. I am 60 years old and this makes my skin feel clean, smooth, and tight. Only thing missing is the fruity/papaya aroma.

I will preface by saying that I am a HUGE fan of Clinique products and having been using their 3 step for over 20 years. I have great skin and am often complemented on my complexion. I thought I'd try this cleanser, but after a couple days' use, I developed an eye infection that my dr is attributing to the fine particles in this exfoliator. The directions do say to avoid the eye area, which I paid careful attention to do. But I think something small and sharp got in to my eye and irritated it quite badly. I will avoid this product from now on.

I used to use Pep-Start cleanser and really liked the one step cleaning and exfoliation. I got this after the Pep-Start was discontinued. This is so much grainier. I cannot use it because it is so harsh on my skin.
This exfoliating cleanser is very good. It's gentle yet very fresh and effective. I prefer it to the 7day scrub as it works better for my combo oily skin.

Casually stumbled upon this as it was part of a set but I truly love this cleanser. It is my favorite! My skins looks amazing after, it's glowing and clean. I love that it's bamboo beads and not who knows what!
this cleanser is one of my favorite product ! it is so effective and removes all the dead cells and leaves the skin so smooth!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This is the best exfoliating product I have used for a very long time.

My weekly routine for over 15 years has been rotate out the (now called) 7-day exfoliating scrub and the daily gentle face cleanser since I was a teenager. This is new to me and I love it! While this product is not the same as the others I mentioned, don't get me wrong, I will keep using those -- but I LOVE THIS! Daily! I can't believe how nicely it spreads and obviously exfoliates gently, rinses so cleanly; love that it's no project to wash my face in the morning or night. .

I am super happy with this product. I purchased it to replace the pepstart exfoliating cleanser that Clinique no longer produces. I am happy with all about clean, as it is very similar to pepstart. I use it daily and do not find it harsh on my skin.

avis.titre: Not a good replacement for Pep Start exfoliating cleanser
avis.texte: I was so disappointed when they got rid of the pink Pep Start exfoliating cleanser. Used that for years. It had great exfoliation and cleansing but never dried out my face. A representative told me to try this, it was the replacement. I have normal/oily skin, and this one dries out my face and leaves peeling dry patches. And the exfoliation is probably half of what Pep Start was, more like a barely there massage beads vs the invigorating scrub of Pep Start. I went and bought all close out Pep Start I could at places online now it's super expensive, so I'm going to have to find a new cleanser. Very disappointed a good product was replaced with one that is no where near the same. Even with constant moisturizer (which I never used to have to use), I still get dry peeling spots using this scrub.

I absolutely love this product! I use it twice a day & it leaves my face feeling smooth & refreshed. I love all my Clinique skin care & make-up products. This is one thing I splurge on to pamper myself. I have been a Clinique person for so many years. Would not dare go to any other product. Samples are always a plus too!

avis.titre: I will continue to use this product
avis.texte: Refreshing and not too harsh. I am allergic to many skin products, this works well for me. Katelyn, the salesperson was very knowledgeable and kind in the Foley Alabama store. She helped decide on several products. Great service.
Love this product. Definitely will and have bought this before
This cleanser has changed my skin! It's gentle yet effective enough to use everyday. My skin is clear, glowy, and soft!
Tried this product before and loved it. Now I'm letting my teenager try it. Hope it will help with his pimple-prone forehead.
This product exfoliates and cleans my skin without being harsh, and gentle enough to not cause irritation for regular use
Smooth & great to use daily...if wanted. Nice scrub, not too harsh on skin.

Was having a hard time finding a cleaner that was perfect for my acne prone skin. This cleaners has helped clear my face within a week of using it. It clears my blackheads with the exfoliate and leaves my skin super soft.
I love love this product, it's one of my favorite face washes. I originally got a sample size one in I loved it so I order the normal size one.

I used the 7 day scrub cream going back so many years that I remember when it came in a little tub and was called 7th day scrub cream. I feel like this new product is better. It is easier to spread on my face and the little beads don't wash away so fast that they aren't useful. I'm post menopausal and my skin is more delicate than it used to be but I find using this every morning or every other morning works well for me. Now that the hormones are gone, I need a little extra help getting the dullness gone.

I'm so happy I tried this from the even better holiday kit! I'm very picky about face cleansers because they either cause break outs or dry out my skin. This feels great on my face and doesn't leave it dry at all! It actually feels moisturizing, and not in a greasy way, like some products that feel like they never wash off. I like that I can feel the exfoliation from the beads too; some cleansers barely have enough exfoliating material and I don't feel anything at all. Extra scratchy for me, please! Get those dead skin cells off! This has replaced my Mario Badescu exfoliating scrub that I've used for years.
I use it as a weekly exfoliating deep cleanser. It feels pretty gentle on the skin, so I guess people with non sensitive skins could use it a little more often than I do. Great cleanser!

I got a travel size of this with the even better holiday set and it works fine. I wash my face with the liquid face soap and used the pep start exfoliating wash about twice a week. This takes a bit of getting used to, and the beads are a bit harsher but it works fine. I have a few more tubes of the pep start, and I'll use these if it came in a set or a GWP but would I buy this? Nope. I have a facial scrub from another brand that works better than this. Clinique has been "improving" and replacing a lot of my long time favorites and it's making me slowly convert to other brands. Superdefense. Moisture Surge Intense. Smart serum. it's just the even better line, liquid soap and clarifying toner left. Sigh.

I can't say this enough!! But I love this stuff!! I am on my second little bottle, it only come in two sizes. Once I am done with this second one I will be buying the larger one! This product really gets the job done! I even use it everyday and I haven't had a problem and I have sensitive skin.

I am 59 years young. I have had two major bouts with severe acne in my adult life where I required Accutane. I have struggled to find a really great cleanser for my skin to alleviate the breakouts and really take away the blackheads which lead to breakouts. I am still under the care of a derm but treatment has not been perfect. I tried this product with much doubt. Boy was I wrong!! This takes awake the blackheads (I following cleansing with the Clinique Clarifying lotion) and makes my skin so much clearer and youthful looking. I get impacted blackheads that are awful and the Covid masks make it worse (despite changing everyday), but this cleanser takes care of everything. I have been using it twice a day, but will caution that you may have to go to one of the other Clinique cleansers as twice a day may be a bit harsh for sensitive skin. I used Clinique in college and moved away from it for some reason. Glad I am back.
This is a great cleaner and just enough exfoliating. Leaves your skin clean and sheen.
Bring back Pepstart 2 in 1exfoliating cleanser! I've tried this new cleanser since Pepstart was discontinued... this stuffnext stuff is making me break out worse than I did when I was a teenager.

This product helps my active, athletic skin feel clean and smooth. I much prefer it to the 7 Day Scrub which always seems to leave a residue. It is gentle enough for my sensitive skin. I do feel like the Pep Start Scrub was better, however, it contained micro plastics and I greatly appreciate that Clinique is moving towards environmentally friendly products like this one.

This cleanser is a light clear gel/ jelly with exfoliating beads. It works well removing oil, dirt, skin care products and SPFs. However, it's misleading since the product is being marketed as for all skin types, and it will be definitely too drying for drier skin types. I would definitely recommend it for oilier skin since I like it better than All about clean cleanser in a pink packaging.
I've been searching for a mild exfoliating cleanser and found the perfect one. Not only does it clean my pores, it leaves my skin so soft I hardly need a moisturizer

I really wanted to like this, but I didn't. It does make my skin feel soft, but I have rosacea and I turned bright red after using this. It was way too rough on my sensitive skin. Unfortunately, I will not be repurchasing.
Just bought this and have used several times. This is a great addition to the cleansers! I also use 7 day scrub, but on alternate days. This really has smoothed out some bumps on my skin!

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel soft and clean!
avis.texte: I originally got this in a set with something else I purchased and fell in love with the way it makes my skin feel, so I ended up buying two full-size bottles. Some exfoliators I've used before are too harsh on the skin, but I love this jelly. It's perfect. Doesn't make me feel like it leaves an after-residue. After I rinse it off, my skin feels refreshed and soft. Love this and will continue to refill my supply for as long as Clinique makes it!
I love this product. It's a perfect combination of cleaning and exfoliating in one.

I love this scrub. I don't understand the other reviewers saying it's too harsh on the skin. It's a scrub, gently exfoliate the skin accordingly. This has worked wonders on my hormonal acne. Even the redness dissipates. Make sure you use it twice a day as directed. Thank you Clinique.
